title: Hello, slightly suspicious server
hint: Keep print("...") and change only the text between the quotes.
objective: Understand the editor, the console and your first print instruction.

title: The deployment countdown
hint: Move the Launch instruction below the two number messages.
objective: Read and write instructions in the order Python executes them.

title: Quotes are not comments
hint: Use single quotes around the full message so its double quotes can stay inside.
objective: Distinguish the text Python prints from notes Python ignores.

title: Numbers do not need costumes
hint: Remove the quotes only from the first line's arithmetic expression.
objective: Distinguish numeric expressions from text that looks like arithmetic.

title: Give your numbers useful names
hint: Put seconds on the left of = and the calculation on its right. Then use print(seconds).
objective: Create a variable, calculate a new value and print it.

title: A name can change its mind
hint: Use jobs = jobs + 2 before the print.
objective: Reassign a variable using its previous value.

title: Text, whole numbers and decimals
hint: Use unquoted 2 with count and quoted "2" with label.
objective: Recognize strings, ints and floats before converting between them.

title: Multiply, divide, and keep the units
hint: Divide the number of jobs by the number of seconds.
objective: Use multiplication, division and parentheses in a named calculation.

title: Full boxes and leftovers
hint: Use // for full_boxes and % for loose_items.
objective: Use integer division and remainder before they appear in larger functions.

title: A tool can give back a value
hint: Assign len(message) to characters; the space is one of the six characters.
objective: Use len and assign its result before printing it.

title: Find a character by its position
hint: The first index is 0 and the last can be reached with -1.
objective: Read string indexes starting at zero.

title: Trim the space around the message
hint: Use a new name for the value returned by raw.strip().
objective: Call one string method and keep its returned result.

title: Lowercase without losing the original
hint: Call status.lower(), including its parentheses.
objective: Use lower as a second example of a string method.

title: Clean up the robot username
hint: Use strip(), lower(), then replace(" ", "_") on their successive results.
objective: Combine familiar string methods with one new replacement rule.

title: Put a value inside a message
hint: Place f immediately before the opening quote, then use {name} and {jobs}.
objective: Build a basic f-string before using format specifiers.

title: A status message worth reading
hint: Use {rate:.2f} for the rate, and ordinary {name} and {count} for the others.
objective: Format a decimal inside an f-string after learning basic interpolation.

title: Numbers wearing string costumes
hint: Use count = int(raw) before doing numeric addition.
objective: Convert valid text to an integer before calculating.

title: Build a tool of your own
hint: Start with def greet():, indent the print by four spaces, and put greet() at the left edge below.
objective: Explain def, a function body and a call before asking for a function.

title: Give your function an input
hint: Put name inside braces in an f-string, rather than inside ordinary text.
objective: Distinguish a parameter in a definition from an argument in a call.

title: Hand a result back
hint: The function needs return number * 2. Its caller prints the returned answer.
objective: Explain return separately from printing before graded function challenges.

title: Return to sender
hint: Multiply the per-item price by quantity before adding the one delivery fee.
objective: Write a function with a clear input/output contract.

title: Defaults without guesswork
hint: Let the signature supply the default; use the received role directly.
objective: Use default parameters and keyword arguments.

title: Small helpers, fewer tiny disasters
hint: Call service_fee inside checkout; add the returned result, not the function object.
objective: Compose functions and reuse a supplied helper.

title: Two answers, one return trip
hint: Use // for the complete minutes and % for the remainder.
objective: Return and unpack tuples without losing the remainder.

title: True, False, and nothing supplied
hint: Use == for value equality and is None for the absence check.
objective: Read a comparison result and distinguish None from zero.

title: Choose which instruction runs
hint: A zero job count makes jobs > 0 False, so the else body must print idle.
objective: Introduce if, else and indentation using a comparison you understand.

title: The door has three rules
hint: Group the two ways to qualify, then apply the ban to that whole group.
objective: Combine comparisons with and, or and not.

title: Choose one response
hint: Check the highest threshold first so lower thresholds do not catch it.
objective: Order if/elif/else branches so specific rules are reachable.

title: Look before you index
hint: Check text before text[0]; make the final result an actual bool.
objective: Use short-circuit evaluation to guard an operation.

title: Missing is not the same as empty
hint: Use is None rather than not supplied or supplied or fallback.
objective: Distinguish truthiness from a precise missing-value test.

title: The decimal that would not behave
hint: Take the absolute difference and compare it with tolerance using <=.
objective: Use tolerances for floating-point comparisons.

title: Boxes, leftovers and division
hint: An exact multiple needs no extra box; any remainder needs one.
objective: Use /, // and % according to the meaning of the result.

title: Parentheses prevent incident reports
hint: Calculate the power before multiplying, then apply min with the cap.
objective: Apply operator precedence and exponentiation deliberately.

title: Names inside and outside a call
hint: Assign label inside the function and return that local name. No global keyword is needed.
objective: Explain local names before mutation or closures.

title: Each call gets fresh local work
hint: Keep the temporary total inside the function, then return the sum.
objective: Initialize call-specific state inside the function.

title: Local names, local business
hint: Choose a new local name for the selected region instead of assigning REGION.
objective: Read a global constant while keeping call-specific variables local.

title: A failing example is a clue
hint: Adding two is different from multiplying by two for most inputs.
objective: Fix one arithmetic rule using known input and expected output.

title: Read the check before changing the code
hint: The fee belongs after the multiplication, rather than inside its parentheses.
objective: Connect an assertion with a precise behavioral rule.

title: The console is not the return value
hint: Use return where the starter uses print.
objective: Recognize a print-versus-return mistake in a graded function.

title: The off-by-one incident
hint: At current == capacity, is there a space left for one more person?
objective: Read a failing assertion and repair a boundary error.

title: Several values, one ordered list
hint: The same len tool that counted string characters counts list items.
objective: Introduce list literals and length before loop-based tasks.

title: First, last, and absolutely not there
hint: Handle emptiness first, then use indexes 0 and -1.
objective: Index sequences safely, including negative indexes.

title: Slices without paper cuts
hint: Handle count == 0 separately before using a negative start index.
objective: Use start:stop:step and understand exclusive bounds.

title: A queue, with manners
hint: Copy before using pop(0), and guard an empty list.
objective: Use list append and pop while understanding mutation.

title: Repeat responsibly
hint: range excludes its stop, so the stop must be n + 1.
objective: Use range and an accumulator with correct inclusive bounds.

title: While the queue is still awake
hint: Make remaining smaller every iteration, and count a batch only when work exists.
objective: Maintain a while-loop invariant and guarantee progress.

title: Skip the nonsense, stop at success
hint: Skip negatives, then return on the first even value. Put return None after the loop.
objective: Use continue and break without skipping valid falsy results.

title: Nested loops, tiny city
hint: Put the row loop outside and the column loop inside.
objective: Traverse a grid in a defined order using nested iteration.

title: Positions and pairs without manual counters
hint: Unpack position and name from enumerate(names, 1), then append their tuple.
objective: Use enumerate and zip after ordinary loops are familiar.

title: Comprehend the work order
hint: Enumerate the original list before applying the non-empty filter.
objective: Transform and filter a sequence with enumerate and comprehensions.

title: Breadcrumbs in the console
hint: Print after the addition, inside the loop; return after the loop.
objective: Trace intermediate state while preserving a useful return value.

title: The bug that only happens twice
hint: Use a local total initialized inside the function. Remove the global assignment.
objective: Detect accidental shared state by calling a function repeatedly.

title: Split the message, join the pieces
hint: Call split() with no argument, then use "-".join on the returned list.
objective: Use lists of words as the bridge between text and collection processing.

title: A dictionary is not a tiny list
hint: Use membership to distinguish a missing key from a stored None.
objective: Use keys, membership and get without confusing absence with None.

title: Update the record, spare the original
hint: Create a new mapping, then apply changes after base.
objective: Merge dictionaries and deliberately copy nested mutable data.

title: Sort the tickets into departments
hint: Get a fresh list for each unseen team, then append that ticket's ID.
objective: Group records with dict.items, setdefault and fresh lists.

title: Invert carefully, the last one wins
hint: Iterate labels.items() and swap the key/value positions in a new dictionary.
objective: Build a dictionary transformation and specify collision behavior.

title: Count API responses
hint: Use dict.get(key, 0) for the first occurrence.

title: One domain, one invitation
hint: Extract the part after @, lowercase it, and collect it in a set.
objective: Use a set to collect unique normalized values.

title: Who is on both shifts?
hint: Added is after minus before; removed is the opposite difference.
objective: Use union, intersection and difference for collection comparison.

title: All permissions, not merely one
hint: Combine a subset test with a no-overlap test.
objective: Check subset and disjointness relationships.

title: Merge the tag clouds
hint: Create set() inside the function and update it with each group.
objective: Accumulate unique values from nested collections without aliasing.

title: Deduplicate job IDs
hint: Only append when the ID is absent from the seen set.

title: Tiny permission switches
hint: Compare the bitwise intersection with the entire required mask.
objective: Represent flags with binary integers and bitwise operators.

title: Reject nonsense at the boundary
hint: Check the type before comparing the range; bool needs rejection too.
objective: Raise a specific exception for an invalid domain value.

title: Catch the error you expect
hint: Catch ValueError and TypeError from int(raw), and return None only in that handler.
objective: Handle selected conversion failures without masking unrelated bugs.

title: Always put the mop away
hint: Return from the try block and close in finally. Do not return from finally.
objective: Use finally for cleanup on success and failure.

title: Type hints are signs, not force fields
hint: Guard the empty case before dividing; / produces a float.
objective: Annotate a function while implementing its runtime contract.

title: Maybe there is no ticket
hint: Use sequence emptiness to choose a result; do not test the first ID's truthiness.
objective: Describe an optional result with a union and preserve valid falsy IDs.

title: Two input types, one honest boundary
hint: Reject unsupported types first, convert next, then reject a negative result.
objective: Narrow union inputs and validate beyond annotations.

title: Validate configuration
hint: Strip first; validate the entire string before converting to int.

title: Typed task records
hint: Validate the original values before building a new dictionary; bool("false") would be True.

title: The list with two name tags
hint: Copy the outer dictionary and create a new tags list before adding the tag.
objective: Distinguish aliasing, shallow copying and nested object mutation.

title: The haunted default argument
hint: Create a fresh result whether jobs is omitted or supplied.
objective: Avoid shared mutable defaults across function calls.

title: Scope and pure functions
hint: Create a new list. A global constant does not need to be assigned inside the function.

title: Invoice totals
hint: Start a total at zero, validate each pair, then add price times quantity.

title: Paginate query results
hint: The starting offset is (page - 1) times size. bool is a subclass of int in Python.

title: Borrow a tool from the standard library
hint: Use import math before calling math.ceil(seconds).
objective: Explain import and module-qualified calls before files or JSON.

title: Keep a helper in another module
hint: The imported function still needs parentheses when you use its result.
objective: Import a provided local module instead of duplicating its rule.

title: Run a script without surprising its importer
hint: Use the existing if/== syntax to compare __name__ with the string "__main__".
objective: Use the __name__ guard after functions and imports are understood.

title: Objects that remember their own jobs
hint: Create self.completed = [] inside __init__, not at class scope.
objective: Create independent instances with attributes and methods.

title: Protect the snack fund
hint: Use _balance for storage and @property for the public read; validate before changing it.
objective: Enforce an invariant through methods and a read-only property.

title: Inheritance, with a real reason
hint: Let the base initializer store units, then add surcharge as subclass state.
objective: Override behavior and use super without duplicating initialization.

title: Compose the delivery crew
hint: Store the supplied transport on self and delegate to its send method.
objective: Use a dataclass for a record and inject a collaborator.

title: Give the error a useful name
hint: Check negative amount first, then insufficient funds, then return the subtraction.
objective: Define and raise a custom exception while retaining ordinary validation.

title: A record with a declared shape
hint: Construct a new dict with the three declared keys; annotations do not build it for you.
objective: Use TypedDict as documentation while constructing a fresh record.

title: A FIFO job queue
hint: Create storage in __init__, not as a mutable class attribute.

title: Pass a tool without running it yet
hint: Use operation as a function name and put value inside its call parentheses.
objective: Use a function as a value before callbacks, lambdas or pipelines.

title: A small anonymous sorting rule
hint: Pass a small function as key, selecting record["name"].
objective: Introduce lambda and key functions before using them in reports.

title: Pure functions, less cleanup
hint: Use the sort key (-score, name) and construct selected fields in fresh dicts.
objective: Transform records immutably and use sorted with a key.

title: Functions that take functions
hint: Start with value, then replace the running result with step(result) for each step.
objective: Pass callbacks and apply a transformation pipeline in order.

title: Test the test, detective
hint: Assert exact results for a zero, a negative and a positive input.
objective: Write assertions that detect several different broken implementations.

title: Lazy work is sometimes good work
hint: Loop over input and yield only matching values; avoid list(...).
objective: Yield values on demand and stop consuming when the caller stops.

title: Functional log aggregation
hint: A generator expression can filter events without an intermediate list.

title: Recursion with an exit sign
hint: Return an integer leaf directly; otherwise combine recursive results from its children.
objective: Use a base case and reduce a nested problem on each call.

title: A counter with a private office
hint: Keep current in the outer function, and use nonlocal current in the returned inner function.
objective: Use a closure and nonlocal for intentionally retained state.

title: Unpack inputs without guessing the signature
hint: Use one star before args and two before kwargs inside the call.
objective: Use * and ** to pass tuple and dictionary arguments.

title: Wrap a function without changing its job
hint: Create an inner wrapper, decorate it with wraps(operation), then return it.
objective: Combine closures and forwarding to build a decorator.

title: Manage a resource with with
hint: The entry method returns self; the exit method restores the flag and returns False.
objective: Implement the context-manager protocol after classes and cleanup are familiar.

title: Files deserve a closing ceremony
hint: Use Path(path).open(encoding="utf-8") in a with block, then filter stripped lines.
objective: Use pathlib, UTF-8 and context-managed file access.

title: JSON is data, not Python in a coat
hint: Decode first, validate list shape and every member type/range, then return.
objective: Decode JSON and validate the resulting runtime values.

title: CSV: commas are allowed in names
hint: DictReader understands quoted fields. Convert each cents field with int before adding.
objective: Use the csv module instead of splitting structured text by hand.

title: Binary search
hint: Use inclusive bounds; move a bound past middle after each unsuccessful comparison.

title: Make a tiny database before building storage
hint: Bind each (name,) to one ? placeholder, then read row[0] from each fetched row.
objective: Use an in-memory SQLite table, bound parameters and fetched rows.

title: SQLite task storage
hint: Use execute(sql, (title,)) with a one-element tuple. Never format a title into SQL.

title: Cache expiry
hint: Store both the value and deadline; do not use truthiness to decide if a value exists.

title: Async without the spaghetti
hint: Build awaitables for every name and await asyncio.gather once.
objective: Await coroutines concurrently while retaining input order.

title: Mission: the noisy incident report
hint: Build a frequency dictionary, then sort its items.
objective: Combine string normalization, counting and deterministic ordering.

title: Mission: reconcile the snack ledger
hint: Use get(account, 0) before adding each signed amount.
objective: Aggregate records while keeping money in integer cents.

title: Mission: the polite rate limiter
hint: Look up a user's count before each decision and increment only when accepted.
objective: Maintain per-key state and make one decision for every event.

title: Mission: the dependency inventory
hint: Deduplicate each project's list before updating the usage dictionary.
objective: Combine nested iteration, uniqueness and stable output.

title: Checkpoint: aliases under pressure
hint: The objects you modify are the outer mapping and its events list. Both need new containers.
objective: Apply copying rules to a nested update without a recipe.

title: Checkpoint: a suspicious fallback
hint: The rule is absence or None, rather than every falsy value.
objective: Repair a truthiness bug and test explicit empty settings.

title: Checkpoint: reshape the response
hint: Filter first, sort using ticket["id"] as the key, then build the output strings.
objective: Select, filter and order records using several core tools.

title: Boss mission: the tiny ticket engine
hint: Copy initial first. Handle add, close and unknown actions as separate branches.
objective: Process a command stream with explicit state transitions and errors.

title: Slices and errors
hint: Check lengths before indexing. Return a descriptive error rather than panicking.

title: Count words with maps
hint: The zero value for a missing map count is zero.

title: Interfaces for storage usage
hint: Range over the interface slice and call the method; no type switch is needed.

title: Preserve error identity
hint: Use the comma-ok map lookup and fmt.Errorf with %w.

title: Strict JSON input
hint: Use DisallowUnknownFields, then perform a second Decode expecting io.EOF.

title: HTTP client with context
hint: NewRequestWithContext attaches cancellation; defer closing the body immediately after a successful Do.

title: A JSON HTTP endpoint
hint: Check the path before the method, and set headers before writing a response body.

title: Ordered concurrent work
hint: Send indices as jobs. Each worker writes only its assigned result index. Close the channel and wait for all workers.
